answer_text: No. The UMG zone text does not impose a condition on new constructions near or on elements recensés under L.151-19 or L.151-23. I scanned the full UMG text (printed pp. 319-331) and found no such wording (c-01)[TEXT plu_reglement page=319-331 scope: full Zone UMG Articles 1-16 and rappels]. Zone UMG corresponds to the Joliot-Curie quartier (c-02)[La zone UMG correspond au quartier Joliot-Curie]. The condition wording appears in zone UA2 (c-03)[Les constructions nouvelles ainsi que les travaux d'aménagement ou d'extension réalisés à proximité ou sur des éléments recensés au titre des articles L151.19 et L151.23 (plan 5.5) doivent être conçus pour préserver]. A general demolition rule covers éléments bâtis recensés (c-04)[y compris les éléments bâtis recensés au titre des articles L.151.19 et L.151-23 du code de l'urbanisme], but it is a permit requirement, not a construction condition.
discrepancy_note: The planner stated that zone UL2 on p. 121 contains the L.151-19/23 wording. PDF p. 121 (printed p. 120) holds only the UL zone introduction, rappels and UL1 prohibitions. The construction-condition wording I verified is in UA2 (printed p. 13). UL2 itself was not located in this run. The UMG conclusion is unaffected.
additional_context: The general demolition rule (c-04) applies to recensed built elements across zones. It is not a UMG-specific construction condition. Whether it reaches UMG parcels should be checked against the general provisions. Parcel-level presence of any recensed element remains unresolved, as the existing unresolved flag states.
